snapshot:
- banner:
  - heading "Dairy 360" [level=1]
  - generic: harness · in memory
  - button "Recording as geist-synthetic · Direct entry"
  - button "Menu · Milk"
  - button "Search ⌘K"
  - 'button "Theme: light. Switch to dark." [active]': light
  - button "Assistant"
- navigation "Section views":
  - link "Milking":
    - /url: /milk/milking
  - link "Dispatch":
    - /url: /milk/dispatch
  - link "Buyers":
    - /url: /milk/buyers
- main:
  - heading "Where the milk went" [level=2]
  - paragraph: One session, and everything that left the bulk in it — sold and kept. The dodhi and the house are on every sheet; a neighbour appears only when they took something.
  - generic: Date
  - textbox "Date": 2026-09-29
  - generic: Session
  - radiogroup "Session":
    - radio "Morning" [checked]:
      - generic: "1"
      - generic: Morning
    - radio "Evening":
      - generic: "2"
      - generic: Evening
  - generic: Handed over by (optional)
  - combobox "Handed over by (optional)"
  - generic: Person who handed over the milk, if known. Use a stable identifier, not a display name.
  - paragraph: Defaults to today and this session — the one place a date is defaulted, because today is a fact rather than a guess. Change it to enter a session you missed.
  - region "Standing dispatch quantities":
    - generic: Every session — leave none of these unanswered
    - table:
      - rowgroup:
        - 'row "Not answered Bashir (dodhi) Yesterday morning: No record Rate: Rs 7,000.00 / 40 L Litres for Bashir (dodhi) Nothing taken by Bashir (dodhi) Amount: No record"':
          - cell "Not answered Bashir (dodhi)":
            - generic: Not answered
            - text: Bashir (dodhi)
          - 'cell "Yesterday morning: No record"': "Yesterday morning: –"
          - 'cell "Rate: Rs 7,000.00 / 40 L"'
          - cell "Litres for Bashir (dodhi) Nothing taken by Bashir (dodhi)":
            - generic: Litres for Bashir (dodhi)
            - textbox "Litres for Bashir (dodhi) — 2026-09-29 morning"
            - generic: L
            - button "Nothing taken by Bashir (dodhi)": nothing taken
          - 'cell "Amount: No record"': "Amount: –"
        - 'row "Not answered Homekept, not sold Yesterday morning: No record Rate: not billed Litres for Home Nothing taken by Home Amount: No record"':
          - cell "Not answered Homekept, not sold":
            - generic: Not answered
            - text: Homekept, not sold
          - 'cell "Yesterday morning: No record"': "Yesterday morning: –"
          - 'cell "Rate: not billed"'
          - cell "Litres for Home Nothing taken by Home":
            - generic: Litres for Home
            - textbox "Litres for Home — 2026-09-29 morning"
            - generic: L
            - button "Nothing taken by Home": nothing taken
          - 'cell "Amount: No record"': "Amount: –"
    - navigation "Standing destinations pagination":
      - generic: 1–2 of 2
  - region "Occasional dispatch quantities":
    - generic: Only if they came — nothing to answer here
    - navigation "Occasional destinations pagination":
      - generic: 1–3 of 3
    - table:
      - rowgroup:
        - row "Ali (next door) Rs 9,000.00 / 40 L Record milk taken by Ali (next door)":
          - cell "Ali (next door) Rs 9,000.00 / 40 L"
          - cell "Record milk taken by Ali (next door)":
            - button "Record milk taken by Ali (next door)": they took some
        - row "Bibi (corner house) Rs 9,000.00 / 40 L Record milk taken by Bibi (corner house)":
          - cell "Bibi (corner house) Rs 9,000.00 / 40 L"
          - cell "Record milk taken by Bibi (corner house)":
            - button "Record milk taken by Bibi (corner house)": they took some
        - row "Imran (milk allowance) not billed Record milk taken by Imran (milk allowance)":
          - cell "Imran (milk allowance) not billed"
          - cell "Record milk taken by Imran (milk allowance)":
            - button "Record milk taken by Imran (milk allowance)": they took some
  - generic: Out 0 L · billed Rs 0.00
  - generic: Measured this session 0 L
  - paragraph: Production this session is a lower bound — 6 in milk with no row yet. Milk going out can exceed it, and that is the missing measurement rather than missing milk.
  - button "Go to first unanswered destination"
  - text: "Still to answer: Bashir (dodhi), Home."
  - text: 0 of 2
  - text: answered
  - generic: required destinations
  - button "Save session" [disabled]
